providers.free_tier_note: Free via NVIDIA Developer Program. 40 RPM. No credit expiry.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.description: High-intelligence flagship model for complex, multi-step tasks
models.description_long: GPT-4o is OpenAI's flagship model, designed for high-intelligence tasks that require complex reasoning and multi-modal understanding. It excels in software engineering, complex data analysis, and creative problem solving.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.description: Affordable and intelligent small model for fast, lightweight tasks
models.description_long: GPT-4o mini provides a perfect balance of intelligence and incredible speed. It is optimized for high-volume, lightweight tasks like customer support automation, basic data extraction, and rapid prototyping.

models.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
models.description: Most intelligent model, hybrid reasoning capabilities
models.description_long: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is the first hybrid reasoning model, capable of both instantaneous responses and extended, visible 'thinking' for complex graduate-level problems. It sets the industry standard for software engineering and nuanced instruction following.

models.name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
models.description: Fastest model, optimized for speed and cost
models.description_long: Claude 3.5 Haiku is Anthropic's fastest model. It matches the intelligence of previous flagship models like Claude 3 Opus while operating at the speed and cost of a lineage model. Perfect for real-time applications.

models.name: Nova 2
models.description: Deepgram's highly accurate, general-purpose speech-to-text model

models.name: Nova 3
models.description: Deepgram's latest high-performance speech-to-text model

models.name: Whisper Cloud
models.description: Fully managed Whisper model, deployed by Deepgram

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.description: Google's most capable model with advanced reasoning and thinking levels
models.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google's most capable model for complex reasoning. With its massive 1M+ token context window, it can ingest entire codebases, hours of video, or thousands of documents in a single turn.

models.name: Gemini 3 Pro
models.description: Best for complex tasks requiring broad world knowledge across modalities
models.description_long: Gemini 3 Pro brings advanced multimodal understanding and world knowledge. It is highly optimized for creative collaboration and solving deep logical puzzles across text and images.

models.name: Gemini 3 Flash
models.description: Pro-level intelligence at the speed and pricing of Flash
models.description_long: Gemini 3 Flash is built for scale. It offers reasoning capabilities that rival larger models while maintaining extremely low latency, making it the ideal choice for high-frequency multimodal applications.

models.name: Nano Banana Pro
models.description: Highest quality image generation model yet

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick 17B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Fast reasoning model.
models.description_long: Llama 4 Maverick is an elite 400B+ parameter MoE model optimized by NVIDIA for maximum inference speed. It represents the pinnacle of open-weights multimodal performance.

models.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Efficient instruct model.
models.description_long: Llama 4 Scout is a highly efficient 17B model designed for rapid response times and low-resource deployment while maintaining Llama 4's superior instruction-following DNA.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: High quality open model.
models.description_long: Llama 3.3 70B is a massive leap over previous 70B models, providing GPT-4 level intelligence in an open-weights package, heavily optimized for tool calling and RAG.

models.name: Nemotron-3 Nano 30B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Fast MoE model optimized for agentic reasoning.
models.description_long: Nemotron-3 Nano 30B is a breakthrough open MoE model designed for sub-second agentic reasoning. It activates only 3.2B parameters per forward pass, achieving up to 3.3x higher throughput than comparable dense models.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: SOTA open code model.
models.description_long: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B is a state-of-the-art open coding model that rivals GPT-4o's programming performance. Optimized for instruction-following code repair and generation across 92 programming languages.

models.name: Qwen 3.5 VLM 397B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Native multimodal MoE model.
models.description_long: Qwen 3.5 VLM 397B is NVIDIA's flagship open multimodal model, supporting 201 languages and advanced video analysis. Its efficient architecture is up to 19x faster than previous generation dense models.

models.name: Cosmos Reason2 8B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Physical AI reasoning model.
models.description_long: Cosmos Reason2 8B is a specialized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model designed for Physical AI. It excels in reasoning about physics, spatio-temporal dynamics, and generating direct motor commands for robotics.

models.name: Kimi K2.5
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Trillion-param native multimodal agent.
models.description_long: Kimi K2.5 is a trillion-parameter MoE model designed for Visual Agentic Intelligence. It can coordinate up to 100 specialized agents in parallel and generates code directly from visual UI wireframes and videos.

models.name: Minimax-M2.1
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Infinite context agent.
models.description_long: Minimax M2.1 is an industry outlier with a massive 4-million token context window. It uses linear-complexity modeling to ingest entire libraries and codebases without the exponential cost of standard transformers.

models.name: Parakeet CTC 0.6B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Fast English ASR.

models.name: NV EmbedQA E5 v5
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: High quality embeddings.

models.name: NV RerankQA Mistral 4B v3
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Text reranker.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.1
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Elite Reasoning & Agentic model.
models.description_long: DeepSeek V3.1 is a massive 671B parameter hybrid reasoning model. It introduces optimized tool-calling and search agents, significantly reducing hallucinations while providing high reasoning performance.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Terminal-optimized reasoning model.
models.description_long: DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus is a refined version of the V3.1 model, specifically tuned for CLI stability and agentic terminal workflows. It fixes multilingual character anomalies and excels in complex code generation.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Efficient reasoning model.
models.description_long: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B leverages the reasoning CoT of the massive R1 models in a compact 8B package. Perfect for low-latency reasoning on edge hardware.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Powerful distilled reasoning model.
models.description_long: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B represents a superior balance of size and reasoning quality. It captures the deep multi-step logic of the 671B model while remaining highly efficient for general production use.

models.name: Qwen 3 Coder 480B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Massive open-weights coder.
models.description_long: Qwen 3 Coder 480B is the top-tier coding variant of the Qwen 3 series. It provides unmatched reasoning depth for system architecture and complex logic repairs in over 100 programming languages.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: The original open flagship.
models.description_long: Llama 3.1 405B is the first open-weights model to rival GPT-4o in general knowledge and reasoning depth. It remains a reliable baseline for complex instruction following and synthetic data generation.

models.name: Mistral Large 2512
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Multilingual MoE powerhouse.
models.description_long: Mistral Large 3 (2512) is the latest MoE flagship from Mistral AI. With 675B total parameters and native vision, it offers an unprecedented 256K context window and elite multilingual performance.

models.name: GLM-5 744B MoE
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Advanced agentic MoE.
models.description_long: GLM-5 744B is a massive MoE transformer optimized for long-horizon agentic tasks. It uses DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to maintain 200k+ context performance with significantly reduced memory pressure.

models.name: Nemotron Nano 12B VL
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Fast Vision-Language Agent.
models.description_long: Nemotron Nano 12B VL is NVIDIA's most efficient visual agent. With a 128k context window and specialized visual reasoning, it is perfect for rapid document parsing and analyzing long-duration video feeds.

models.name: Qwen3 Next 80B
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Ultra-long context hybrid MoE model.
models.description_long: Qwen3 Next 80B is part of the next-generation Qwen series, optimized for massive multilingual support and long-context reasoning with a highly efficient hybrid MoE architecture.

models.name: Nemotron Super 49B v1.5
models.description: NVIDIA NIM: Elite reasoning model.
models.description_long: Nemotron Super 49B is a specialized version of Llama 3.3, further refined by NVIDIA with Reinforcement Learning (RL) to achieve superhuman instruction following and world-class reasoning quality.
